{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Builds, tests & co

on:
  - pull_request
  - push
  - workflow_dispatch

permissions: read-all

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - macos-latest
          # - windows-latest

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout tree
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set-up OCaml
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v3
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: 5

      - name: Cache opam dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.opam
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-opam-${{ hashFiles('*.opam') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-opam-

      - run: opam install . --deps-only --with-test

      - run: opam exec -- dune build

      - run: opam exec -- dune runtest

  lint-doc:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout tree
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Set-up OCaml
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v3
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: 5
      - uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml/lint-doc@v3

  lint-fmt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout tree
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Set-up OCaml
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v3
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: 5
      - uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml/lint-fmt@v3

  lint-opam:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout tree
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Set-up OCaml
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v3
        with:
          ocaml-compiler: 5
      - uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml/lint-opam@v3",
  "rationale": "The build job repeatedly fetches and installs OCaml/opam dependencies on every run with no cache. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) reports a benefit and its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs, and cache inputs can be keyed on the repository's opam file(s) plus the pinned runner/OCaml compiler. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.opam before `opam install` reuses installed dependencies across runs while keeping `opam install`, `dune build`, and `dune runtest` unchanged, so build and test coverage is preserved. No permissions are weakened, no privileged actions/secrets/publishing are added, and actions/cache uses the built-in Actions cache service rather than new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
